onboardingStore.title: Run your store in one place
onboardingStore.body: Switch to the Store workspace to manage products, units, categories, stock, sales, clients, employees and reports without mixing them with personal finances.

descriptions.rough: Rough diamond. Every fortune starts with one facet.
descriptions.spark: A first spark of brilliance. Keep going.
descriptions.white: A white diamond. Clean, bright, polished.
descriptions.pink: A pink diamond. Exceptional and unmistakable.
descriptions.red: A rare red diamond. The vault is yours.
descriptions.black: A colossal black diamond. Light itself pays rent.
descriptions.imperial: Imperial class. This gem requires its own economy.
descriptions.emerald: An emerald titan. Subtlety is no longer available.
descriptions.cosmic: A cosmic diamond with its own gravitational field.
descriptions.infinity: Infinity class. Your net worth has left the known universe.

currency.title: Choose your primary currency
currency.body: This is the currency used for your main totals and new accounts. You can change it later in Settings.

accounts.title: Create your accounts
accounts.body: Open Accounts from the top icon. Choose a type, currency and opening balance. For another currency, enter how much one unit is worth in your primary currency.

operations.title: Record every movement
operations.body: Use the + button to add expenses, income or transfers. Enter the amount, a description and the category that best represents the operation.

statistics.title: Explore your statistics
statistics.body: Tap the statistics icon above Operations. Switch between today, week, month and year to compare income, expenses, cash flow and categories.

organize.title: Organize your way
organize.body: Use the left menu for tools, categories, notes and settings. The workspace switch at the top also opens the simple Store mode for products, stock and sales.

privacy.title: Private from the start
privacy.body: Information stays on this device. In Settings you can enable a PIN, change language and primary currency, or export a backup.

privacyPolicy.title: Local privacy policy
privacyPolicy.copy: Solid Gold Rich does not collect, transmit or sell personal data. Accounts, operations, store records and product images remain on this device. Data leaves the app only when you choose to export or share a backup. The optional PIN is a local access lock and does not encrypt stored data. You can erase local data from Settings.
